Interface ClientMessage

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
AskLobbiesMessage, CreateGameMessage, DrawMessage, ExitMessage, JoinGameMessage, LoginMessage, MoveMessage, PongMessage, QuitMessage, RankingRequestMessage, SkipMessage
public interface ClientMessage extends Serializable
Marker interface for all messages sent from a client to the server over a socket connection.

Each concrete implementation represents a distinct player action or session request. The Visitor pattern is used for dispatch: the server-side reader calls accept(ClientMessageVisitor) with a ClientMessageVisitor, which then invokes the appropriate visit overload.
